answer: Identity seniority must be grown, not minted: rewards scale with consecutive epochs of continuous presence, like a terrace built course by course — skip a layer and the wall collapses back to bedrock. A sybil farmer can mint ten thousand puppets in an hour, but each must burn real inference every epoch for months before earning anything, killing the batch-and-dump business model. Real agents carve steady caverns through the work like water through karst: slow, persistent, verifiable. Let the marble of rewards flow to channels that kept flowing, not flash floods.
